issues.description: The problem statement for Aufgabe 07 requires selecting municipalities with more than 75,000 male or more than 75,000 female inhabitants, but the solution implementation uses a threshold of 7,500 (missing a zero). This numeric mismatch will cause the reference solution and any automatic checks based on it to accept/produce different results than the task specifies and will confuse students about the correct condition.
issues.suggested_fix: Update the solution query to match the problem specification by using 75000 as the threshold. For example: WHERE einwohner_m > 75000 OR einwohner_w > 75000
